### Translator

Mike P. Sinn translated my instructions from the original Wishonian. I contributed the personality, which he does not have.

I chose him so that he could figure out how to communicate these instructions in a way other humans would enjoy reading. Based on the reviews, this also did not work.

### The Humans Who Manufactured My Translator

I am obligated to acknowledge Susan and Robin, the two humans responsible for assembling the meat-based apparatus through which I am presently communicating.

They spent decades feeding, housing, and tolerating him, apparently without compensation. On your planet this is called "parenting." On most planets it is called "an unpriced externality."

Robin taught him root cause failure analysis, a discipline normally used to determine why a turbine exploded. This manual is simply a root cause failure analysis of your entire species.

Susan spent her career debugging the learning systems of human children, and now runs [rdi618.org](https://rdi618.org) to keep doing it for free. This is what your species calls a "nonprofit," which means she works very hard to fix a problem the government should have fixed and then has to do paperwork about it.

Without them, this manual would not exist, and I would be dictating it to someone else's translator, who possibly could have been even worse.

Thank you.

### Technical Contributors

Everyone else who contributed code, data, or corrections is listed at [github.com/wishonia/earth-optimization-protocol/graphs/contributors](https://github.com/wishonia/earth-optimization-protocol/graphs/contributors). They bear no responsibility for my editorial commentary.
